subject: Private deployment pricing discussion: bucketized credits & platform-fee amortization
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearspring.health>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment pricing — scenario request & support tiers

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the intro earlier. We're finalizing our internal budget and need a few concrete commercial scenarios to present to procurement next week. High-level asks:

- Can Redwood amortize the platform fee over a 24-month pilot (rather than annual billing)? We'd prefer the cost to be smoothed.
- We're aiming for two on-prem sites (primary + DR), ~10 operator licenses, and a baseline SRE oncall retainer. Can you show: (A) flat platform fee + per-operator license pricing, (B) anchored commit (12/24/36) with staggered discounts, and (C) a consumption-first model with platform-fee credits? 
- Oncall: we need clarity on included hours vs retainer and the mechanics of "oncall credits" if we choose to credit against the retainer.

Attached is our RFP summary; procurement will be on a tight timeline — they'd like terms within 10 business days.

Can you send a short deck or spreadsheet with scenarios and a suggested counter? If possible, include proposed SLA tiers and what's in our support retainer (response windows, escalation path).

Thanks,

Olivia Park
VP Procurement
ClearSpring Health
Attachment: clearspring_rfp_summary.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearspring.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-20T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — scenario request & support tiers

Hi Olivia — thanks, received and reviewed the RFP summary.

Quick note back while we prepare the detailed scenarios.

We can model three commercial pathways per your ask. High-level tradeoffs we'll include:

- Scenario A (Simple): Flat annual platform fee + per-operator license. Lowest commercial complexity, predictable invoicing, limited credits.
- Scenario B (Anchored commit): Discounting tied to committed spend/term; platform fee amortized across commit term (12/24/36). Offers largest upfront discount in exchange for longer commitment.
- Scenario C (Consumption-first): Lower platform fee + overage metering and platform-fee credits applied against usage. Best when usage is uncertain.

I'll loop Marissa and Irene for the detailed numbers and a short spreadsheet we can share with procurement. Any preferences on anchor term length (if you had a bias toward 24 months, we can show 12/24/36 variants). Also flag whether the DR site is standby-only or active for compute sizing — that changes node counts.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

(On internal note: Marissa — see procurement timeline; suggest we prepare a pilot-friendly 24-month amortization example with a 20% pilot credit and a 12/24/36 anchor matrix. Irene — please flag any legal constraints on amortization language/value recognition.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearspring.health>
Date: 2026-01-21T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — scenario request & support tiers

Grace / Irene / Olivia,

Attaching a quick spreadsheet with three modeled scenarios (pilot = 12 nodes operational equivalent): vpc_pricing_scenarios.xlsx

Key proposals (ballpark; can tighten once we get final node counts):

- Platform fee baseline (annual list): $180,000
- Operator license: $2,400/year per operator (volume discounts at 10+)

Suggested counters:

Option 1 — Flat model
- Platform fee: $170k/year (5.5% discount)
- Operator: $2,200/license/year
- Support: Gold retainer (24/7 P1 response 1 hr, 24/7 oncall) — $75k/year

Option 2 — Anchored commit (recommended)
- 12-mo: platform fee amortized, effective discount 8%
- 24-mo: platform fee amortized, effective discount 18% + 10% pilot credit applied to first invoice
- 36-mo: platform fee amortized, effective discount 25% + 15% pilot credit
- Oncall: include 150 SRE hours/year for 24-mo anchor; additional hours billed at blended rate.

Option 3 — Consumption-first
- Platform fee reduced to $90k/year with usage credits: first 1B tokens/month included, overage at $0.002/token
- Offer platform-fee credit equal to 30% of platform fee applied as invoice credit if usage > X during pilot period

Oncall credits mechanics (proposal):
- If customer buys a support retainer, we can convert a portion (up to 40%) into 'SRE hours credits' redeemable toward project work or incident response; unused credits do not roll over beyond contract term.

Attachments: vpc_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet), internal_commentary.txt (internal margin note)

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vpc_pricing_scenarios.xlsx

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearspring.health>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procurement.corp>, Legal Team <legal@clearspring.health>
Date: 2026-01-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — scenario request & support tiers

Thanks Grace/Marissa — spreadsheet looks useful.

A few clarifications and a counter-proposal from procurement:

- We prefer the 24-month anchor but want the pilot credit front-loaded: 30% applied to the first 3 invoices (not a one-off). That helps our CFO with runway.
- Oncall: rather than an annual retainer charge, can Redwood include 200 SRE hours/year for 24 months as part of the retainer (we'll accept a slightly higher platform fee in exchange)?
- Platform fee amortization: yes to amortize over 24 months; need the contract language to show amortization schedule and credit application to invoices.
- SOC2 + deployment checklist: procurement requires SOC2 Type II and a runbook excerpt for incident response. We'll need these attached to the SOW.

Procurement timeline: target signature by end of next week if we can align terms and DocuSign flow. Ben is on copy and will coordinate final PO processing.

Olivia

Olivia Park
VP Procurement
ClearSpring Health

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearspring.health>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-23T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — scenario request & support tiers

Olivia — thanks, we can accommodate the 24-month amortization with the front-loaded pilot credit structure you requested. Draft summary of final commercial points below:

- Anchor: 24-month commitment
- Platform fee (list): $180,000/year; agreed amortization over 24 months
- Pilot credit: 30% of platform fee applied across first three monthly invoices
- Oncall: include 200 SRE hours/year bundled into Gold retainer for 24 months
- Operator licenses: 10 x $2,200/year (volume price applied)
- SLA: Gold (P1 1 hour; P2 4 hours); separate SOW to list runbook excerpts and SOC2 link

Next steps:
1) Marissa will produce the final SOW and pricing spreadsheet with line-item amortization schedule.
2) I'll seed legal's commercial addendum with amortization and credit mechanics; expect markups within 48 hours.
3) Grace / Marissa to circulate DocuSign link when SOW is ready. We will include SOC2 Type II and incident runbook excerpt in the shared Drive link.
